items.title: Bessent Axing 20-Year Treasury May Send Yields Higher, BNP Warns
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent should resist calls to ax the 20-year bond, as doing so could send borrowing costs higher, according to BNP Paribas SA.

items.title: RBA Frets Potential AI Stock Slump Could Hit Australian Spending
items.summary: Australian households have significant exposure to artificial-intelligence stocks, leaving consumer spending and the broader economy vulnerable to a sharp correction, according to internal Reserve Bank documents.

items.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq reach record closing highs as focus pivots to earnings
items.summary: The US stock market finished on a high note, buoyed by stabilizing crude prices and easing Treasury yields, offering much-needed relief to investors. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq celebrated record closing highs, indicative of a widespread market upturn. With third-quarter earnings just around the corner, excitement is building among analysts and investors, especially with notable announcements from companies like AMD and…

items.title: British Airways A380 makeover: World’s biggest business class, 30% fewer economy seats and 5 other key changes
items.summary: The carrier will refurbish all 12 of its A380 aircraft, introducing a new business-class cabin that spans the entire upper deck. British Airways has described it as the world’s biggest business-class cabin.

items.title: US Treasuries Yields Fall From 2002 High as Oil Prices Dip
items.summary: US bond yields fell from their highest levels since 2002 as oil prices stabilized and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent insisted the government’s debt load can be tamed.

items.title: Kalshi launches perpetual futures tied to US 500 stock index
items.summary: Kalshi has introduced a new perpetual futures contract that is linked to its US 500 index. This contract will allow traders to hold positions indefinitely, without the need to roll over. It aims to provide stock market exposure, a key step in Kalshi's expansion as a financial exchange. The CEO mentioned leveraging long or short positions on the stock index.

items.title: Services activity hits 3-month high in September on demand surge
items.summary: The HSBC India Services Business Activity Index rose to 55.2 in September from 54.1 in August, although it remained below the 60.9 recorded in September 2025. A reading above 50 indicates expansion in activity, while a figure below that signals contraction.

items.title: World Bank bumps up FY27 India growth outlook to 7.1%
items.summary: The World Bank has increased the growth forecast for India's FY27 to 7.1% from earlier estimates. This revision is attributed to strong domestic demand and solid exports, despite global challenges. Growth is expected to moderate later in FY27 but rebound in the medium term. However, risks such as higher global oil prices and El Nino-related disruptions could impact performance.

items.title: Stable institutions, steady pursuit of reforms will steer India to 2047 goal: Jean-Claude Trichet
items.summary: India's journey to becoming a developed nation by 2047 hinges on institutional stability and sustained economic reforms. Former European Central Bank president Jean-Claude Trichet emphasizes the importance of resilient democratic institutions. He cautions against the risks posed by global over-indebtedness and market corrections. Trichet believes AI will bring challenges and benefits in the long run but highlights…

items.title: GST Council to focus on auto refunds, swifter ITC, fewer notices
items.summary: The government is preparing to transition the GST regime toward a trust-based tax administration. This shift includes introducing sweeping decriminalisation for tax offenses, suggesting fewer notices for invoice mismatches and doing away with arrests without evidence or prior to prosecution, aiming for "enforcement to work through money rather than custody".

items.title: Factories of future: Built on 25 years of reform & execution
items.summary: India's industrial sector has seen significant growth under Modi's leadership, emphasising infrastructure development and reforms. The Vibrant Gujarat Summit initiated a strategic approach to enhance ease of doing business. Recent trade agreements have expanded access to global markets for Indian manufacturers.

items.title: Codelco Probes New Signs of Overstated Chile Copper Production
items.summary: Codelco is investigating fresh evidence that copper production may have been double counted in 2024 and 2025, raising further questions over output figures at the Chilean state-owned miner.

items.title: SAP to acquire workforce data firm TechWolf
items.summary: SAP has confirmed its plans to acquire TechWolf, a company renowned for its expertise in workforce data analysis. This strategic move is intended to bolster SAP's comprehension of customer workforce skills and needs in the evolving landscape of AI. Although TechWolf will retain its autonomy and continue to serve its current non-SAP clients, SAP aims to finalize this transaction by the fourth quarter, subject to…

items.title: Gold industry expects price rise to $5,013 an ounce over 12 months
items.summary: Gold prices are set to soar to $5,013 per ounce in the next year, while silver is expected to jump from $61 to $97 per ounce. In addition, LBMA officials foresee platinum prices climbing to $1,914 an ounce and palladium rising to $1,415. This outlook occurs against a backdrop of rising interest rate worries and geopolitical strains that continue to shape the market landscape.

items.title: US EIA lifts Brent forecast to $98 as Iran war tightens global supplies
items.summary: The US Energy Information Administration has revised its oil price forecasts for the coming years due to supply issues. Global benchmark Brent crude is expected to average approximately $98 a barrel in 2026. Retail diesel prices are projected to remain high initially before gradually declining to around $4.50 in 2027. Improvements in Middle Eastern oil production are anticipated as transit routes become safer and…

items.title: Gujarat Natural Resources sets November 5 as record date for the first-ever stock split. Details here
items.summary: Gujarat Natural Resources announced a record date of November 5, 2026, for a proposed 1:10 stock split after shareholder approval. Each ₹10 share will convert into 10 shares valued at Re 1, enhancing shareholder participation in the company's oil and gas exploration business.

items.title: PhysicsWallah exits student lending, sells ₹96 crore loan book to Auxilo
items.summary: PhysicsWallah exits direct student lending as FinZ Finance sells its ₹95.79 crore loan book to education-focused NBFC Auxilo Finserve.

items.summary: Dairy unions have sought higher prices as cattle feed, fodder, veterinary medicines, processing, transportation and packaging costs continue to rise

items.title: NTPC to buy 10 million tonnes of coal from commercial mines in H2 FY27 as power demand rises
items.summary: The state-run power generator is tapping commercial miners to meet a projected 300 MT coal requirement in FY27 as rising heat fuels electricity demand.

items.title: GST Council aims to ease compliance, expedite refunds, curb frequent rate tweaks
items.summary: The GST Council's Thursday meeting, led by Union finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman, will also consider a proposal to expedite GST registration for most businesses to three working days from more than three weeks now.
